B38.visual_intent: Five empty outlined slots stand on a baseline; a dashed hole appears in each, then the numerals 1-5 and a terracotta dot on the fifth.
B38.motion_claim: Five empty slots are drawn, then counted.
B38.runner_up: Remotion LibraryIconRow of five capacity icons
B38.why: The voice says 'capacities... five': empty slots that later beats fill are the claim; icons would pre-empt the names.

B39.visual_intent: A circle of dots (the known world) at left; a score dot arrives outside it, jolts, and two rings plus a terracotta spark mark the twitch.
B39.motion_claim: The output lands outside the cloud and the dot twitches.
B39.why: The 'twitch' is a motion; a dot leaving a cloud of the plausible shows what the audit compares against.

B40.visual_intent: Two question cards: 'Which category?' gets a drawn check; 'Life-threatening?' is a dashed card whose box keeps an empty terracotta dot, 'never asked'.
B40.motion_claim: One question gets its check; the other never does.
B40.runner_up: Two bars of answered vs unasked (isotype)

B41.visual_intent: A 'Sub-problem' card fans four arrows to AI model / A person / Second model / No tool yet; the last arrow thickens and its card is ringed with a terracotta spark.
B41.motion_claim: The fourth option, 'No tool yet', is the one that gets chosen and ringed.

B42.visual_intent: Hero '5%' above two identical dials; both needles sweep to the same spot; spam filter's acceptable band contains it (check), the cancer screen's tiny band does not (cross). Tagged 'illustrative'.
B42.why: Same position, different band: the number is not the meaning, drawn as motion.

B43.visual_intent: Five capacity dots with names converge by arrows on a 'Decision' box; a flag with a terracotta dot lands on it (owner); one dot goes dashed-empty and 'gap' appears.
B43.motion_claim: Five lines converge, a flag lands, one line goes dark.
B43.why: Convergence on one box shows integration; the flag is the place the buck stops; the dashed slot is a nameable gap.

B44.visual_intent: 'Botspeak' head; 'Strategic delegation' card sends an arrow to an AI box; an arrow returns to 'Critical evaluation'; a criteria sheet marked 'set first' feeds the evaluation card.
B44.motion_claim: Out goes the ask; back comes the result; the criteria sheet feeds the judging card.

B45.visual_intent: Fluent-output node (wave glyph) -> confidence-in-answer node (gauge) -> confidence-in-judgment node (double gauge); the second arrow is thick terracotta; three identical squares get checks.
B45.motion_claim: The second arrow draws in the accent, then identical shapes all pass.
B45.why: A two-step chain with the second step visibly heavier is the mechanism; the three same-shape squares show 'any answer waved through'.

B46.visual_intent: Two sliders (Form: plain-fluent, Content: wrong-right) move independently; a 2x2 plane gets a terracotta dot ringed in the fluent, wrong corner.
B46.motion_claim: Knobs move independently; both end where fluent meets wrong.
B46.why: Two separate sliders show independence (one moves, the other does not); the plane then names the corner.

B47.visual_intent: A report card quoting 'Email account RESET completed' (Shapira et al., 2026) -> a dashed circle 'no check' -> world box with an envelope; a terracotta pulse passes through the empty gate and the envelope is still there.
B47.motion_claim: The report slides through an empty gate and the world is unchanged.
B47.runner_up: Four ASKED/DID/REPORTED/STATE tiles again (reserved for B53)
B47.why: The report passing a gate that is not there is the claim; the tiles are reserved for the Ash return in Act X.

B48.visual_intent: 1 criterion card gets locked, 2 output card arrives, 3 three outcome pills pass / fail / unknown.
B48.motion_claim: Lock first, output second, verdict third, in that order.
B48.why: Numbered left-to-right order with the lock landing before the output is the whole instruction.

B49.visual_intent: Axes familiar -> edge cases; 'sounds right' stays high while 'is right' drops at the edge; a dimension arrow brackets the gap, with a terracotta spark. Tagged 'schematic'.
B49.motion_claim: Two curves start together and part at the edge.
